query.description: SODA query against any data.cdc.gov dataset (catalog alias or 4x4 id).

$where.desc: SoQL filter; quote text values: state = 'New York' AND year = '2017'

$order.desc: SoQL order; default :id gives stable paging

csv.description: Same query as CSV (for manual download in a browser).

leading_death.name: Leading Causes of Death
leading_death.description: U.S. leading causes of death by state and year (1999–2017, final; no newer release on data.cdc.gov)

life_expectancy.name: Life Expectancy
life_expectancy.description: Life expectancy at birth by race (All Races, Black, White) and sex (1900–2018)

mortality_rates.name: Provisional Mortality Rates
mortality_rates.description: Provisional quarterly death rates by cause: national, by sex, and one rate_<state> column per state (rolling window of about the last three years, e.g. 2023 Q1–2025 Q3 in 2026-10)

places_county.name: PLACES: County Health
places_county.description: County-level health indicators: obesity, diabetes, smoking, depression, sleep, etc. (BRFSS-based)

places_city.name: PLACES: Place (City and Town) Health
places_city.description: Place-level (cities, towns, CDPs) model-based health indicators: obesity, diabetes, smoking, depression, sleep, etc. (BRFSS-based, latest PLACES release); long format like places_county: one row per place and measureid, value in data_value

cities_500_2019.name: 500 Cities: City-level Data, 2019 release (superseded by PLACES)
cities_500_2019.description: Older 500 Cities project: 2016-2017 estimates for 500 large cities only; wide format, one <measure>_crudeprev / _adjprev column per measure; use places_city for current place estimates

covid_cases.name: COVID-19 Cases & Deaths (archived)
covid_cases.description: COVID-19 weekly cases and deaths by state, archived in 2023 after national case reporting ended; current COVID-19 deaths are in weekly_deaths

covid_conditions.name: COVID-19 Conditions
covid_conditions.description: COVID-19 deaths by contributing condition, age group, and state

weekly_deaths.name: Weekly Death Surveillance
weekly_deaths.description: Provisional COVID-19, pneumonia, influenza and total death counts by state (updated weekly, 2020–present); column `group` mixes By Week, By Month, By Year and By Total rows: always filter it, written with backticks (`group` = 'By Week')

disability.name: Disability Prevalence
disability.description: Disability status and types by state: mobility, cognitive, hearing, vision, self-care (BRFSS)

weekly_deaths_by_cause.name: Weekly Deaths by Cause
weekly_deaths_by_cause.description: Weekly deaths by state and cause: heart disease, cancer, diabetes, stroke, COVID, respiratory (2020–2023)

drug_overdose_state.name: Drug Poisoning Mortality by State
drug_overdose_state.description: Drug poisoning/overdose death rates by state, sex, race, and age (1999–2016)

drug_overdose_provisional.name: Provisional Drug Overdose Deaths
drug_overdose_provisional.description: VSRR provisional 12-month-ending drug overdose death counts by state and drug (2015–present, monthly)

life_expectancy_state.name: State Life Expectancy by Sex
life_expectancy_state.description: Life expectancy at birth by state and sex, 2021 only (no year column)

nutrition_obesity.name: Nutrition, Physical Activity & Obesity
nutrition_obesity.description: Adult obesity, physical inactivity, and fruit/vegetable consumption by state from BRFSS

death_rates_historical.name: Historical Death Rates by Cause
death_rates_historical.description: Age-adjusted death rates for major causes (heart disease, cancer, stroke, etc.) since 1900

birth_indicators.name: Quarterly Birth Indicators
birth_indicators.description: Provisional quarterly birth rates, teen births, preterm births, cesarean rates by race/ethnicity
